files.what_breaks_if_deleted: A stage silently dropped from the root package.json `verify` chain (or demoted to a no-op) would go undetected: every later package would pass a gauntlet that no longer runs that stage, reproducing the EMR-SO `run_eval_gate.sh` failure mode that 04-tests-and-evals.md s4.2 names explicitly as the reason this file exists.

A merge gate that selects zero tasks on the candidate it is gating reports green after running nothing, so every later package merges past checks that never executed (review-WP-001-2.md finding b, attempt-3 R-2 remediation).

A root lint config that applies type-aware rules to untyped Node scripts fails the first package that ships one, and a config that fixes it by loosening typed rules silently drops the gate for product code (attempt-4 post-merge maintenance regression, planning/handoffs/WP-001.attempt-4.lease-request.0146.json; corrected and extended at attempt 5 dispatch 8 per review-WP-001-4.md remediations 2 and 3, plus this dispatch's own item 7 root-cause fix for the sec-051 lockfile mutation).

A gate task whose cache key ignores the root config replays a green result for a config change that could have broken every package, which is a merge gate reporting success for work it did not do (attempt-5 maintenance regression, planning/handoffs/WP-001.attempt-5.lease-request.0146.json; CK-138 restated and CK-139 added at dispatch 8 per review-WP-001-4.md remediation 1).

A merged package's check_ids that collide with a different package's ids (in the shared story-test-map.csv or another package's own catalog) make the global catalog ambiguous -- a report against that id cannot say which test it refers to (attempt-5 dispatch-8 item 6, review-WP-001-4.md remediation 4 second half).

attempt-4 post-merge maintenance regression, REWRITTEN at dispatch 8 (review-WP-001-4.md remediation 2) to assert GATE WIRING, not a manual eslint invocation's exit code. The prior version ran eslint directly and called that "the root scripts folder is gated" -- but root package.json's actual verify:lint ("turbo run lint -- --max-warnings 0") only runs each WORKSPACE PACKAGE's own lint script; root scripts/ and eslint.config.mjs sit outside every package, so nothing in the real merge gate reaches them. Now: (1) parses every verify:* (and verify) script for a clause that invokes eslint against "scripts" and "eslint.config.mjs" with --max-warnings 0; (2) requires that stage be (or be chained into) the top-level verify script; (3) runs the found clause for real and asserts exit 0. Expected and observed RED at freeze time: no verify:* script contains such a clause at all -- 0/3 pass. Stays red until the builder wires it.
